notes.title: Sequel in the works!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Firstly thanks for playing the forest of conx. Secondly, a sequel is in the works! This new game will be called: CONE X2

Why not "the forest of conx 2" ? well whenever you google that name a different game may show up which is stealing my advertising (previous sentence was infused with passive aggression) also nobody knows wtf a "conx" is so.. Cone x2 there you go.

[previewyoutube=xQVhiiffyn0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Anyway, this game will be a lot better than the first one, we have improved graphics, improved performance, improved literally everything. This time all the gameplay mechanics will be properly explained so nobody has no idea what to do, this game will have more characters and a better story line, and will have a level system along with sandbox elements of the first game. This game will also be 2d, and the reason why is so that its more strategic to that of something like plants vs zombies, honestly I think having a tower defence game being 3d just confused people more than anything, so the game is 2d now.

If you would like to follow the development of this new game you can check:
discord: [url=https://discord.gg/fhNUTMRpvz]https://discord.gg/fhNUTMRpvz[/url]
Youtube: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Cone_Channel]https://www.youtube.com/@Cone_Channel[/url]
Blue sky: [url=https://bsky.app/profile/aconeishone.bsky.social]https://bsky.app/profile/aconeishone.bsky.social[/url]
Reddit: [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/aconeishone/]https://www.reddit.com/r/aconeishone/[/url]

Please do check out what I have done of the game so far and see if it is something yall will be interested in! Btw this game will cost money.. Because I also need to eat. Before this game is done if you would like to support me you can check out my latest game: Cone flyers mercenaries! (This game is getting multiplayer soon!!)
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3046120/Cone_Flyers_Mercenaries/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3046120/Cone_Flyers_Mercenaries/[/url]

anyway thanks for reading, have fun!

notes.title: Multiplayer Update!
notes.content:
What's up conxers, I know this update has been a long time coming, and we're super excited to give you multiplayer! In addition with the multiplayer, the game has also been ported to the newest version of gamemaker for better performance on modern hardware, and should stop the game bugging with screen recording softwares.
-Game now runs on gamemaker studio 2
-Improved performance
-MULTIPLAYER.
-Fixed many bugs
-Added crafting tab to the computer
-Added weapons
-Added friendly fire
-Added character customization
 -Added multiplayer leaderboards

notes.title: Public Multiplayer Beta Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I know multiplayer is an exciting addition that yall have been waiting for, so we got a public beta here for you that adds the following:

To participate in the beta you need to select "public_beta" in the beta menu in the properties on steam.
You're friends need to have opened the game at least once with the beta version in order to appear on your friends list!

-Multiplayer
-Game engine ported to Gamemaker Studio 2
-Improved performance
-While in multiplayer the cameras show the other person's view
-Three new weapons:
Nail Bat
Pistol
Shotgun
-Fixed the HUD looking stretched
-Players now have a health bar, when it runs out you're dead
-Friendly fire!!
-Many multiplayer cosmetics
-Fixed many bugs and glitches
-Fixed jankiness with recording software and steam overlay
-Crafting tab on the computer
-Updated shaders
-Game now renders using dx11
-Fixed some texture jank
-Removed some stray pixels
-Fixed game lagging out past day 10
-Fixed glob portals not working
-Fixed skybox being attached to player's eyeballs
-Fixed switching the item you're holding not working properly
-Removed mods and level editor because the new engine broke that

notes.title: Multiplayer devlog #1
notes.content: The multiplayer update for The Forest of Conx is going nicely, we are basically done with all the content and are now working to make the multiplayer more stable, and preventing desyncs between players. We will also rework the cone character to be something of a support class for multiplayer. Once we have reached multiplayer to a stable enough degree, we may release a public beta.

notes.title: Multiplayer update coming soon!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has been playing the forest of conx thus far. We have some exciting news! Multiplayer is being added to the forest of conx! Along with multiplayer, also comes an engine switch to the newest version of gamemaker. This engine switch will bring forth a performance boost, no more engine jank (screen recorders fumbling to capture the game window) as well as a better fractal noise shader. We will also be releasing some content with the update, but we won't spoil all that just yet.

We hope to have this update released in a few weeks, happy conxing!

notes.title: Improvements Update
notes.content:
As I have written in the previous news post, I was not happy with the state I left the forest of conx in, especially compared to my other game Cones in Space.

The main problems with the forest of conx were:
-two difficult for new players to figure out what to do
-too hard for new players
-gameplay loop gets very repetitive

I believe to have fixed this by making the tower placing mechanics more intuitive, adding an option to place towers manually rather than using the radar

I have also added more to do in the game by adding building and man-to-man combat! Hopefully this will make the game feel less samey.

The full changelog is:
-fixed bug where dying in a blood moon will not revert the game back to the normal color scheme
-fixed mercenary having incorrect description
-added tooltips to make learning the game easier
-added challenge totems
-made days longer
-using the computer no longer drains power
-added 4 achievements
-fixed the titlecard glitching out
-added jump button (press space)
-added building
-added shooting glob mechanic (Press E)
-fixed being able to move around while inside the computer menu

notes.title: New update coming soon!
notes.content:
I have not updated this game in some time, and I am honestly not proud of the state I left this game in, so this next update will be focused on fixing bugs, making the game less repetitive, and making it easier for new players to figure out what to do.

If you guys have any suggestions on things that could be added to the forest of conx, please leave them in the comments, it would be much obliged!
